BPC-SC-001.title: Real Google registration creates and returns to one owner
BPC-SC-001.given: real Google project and fresh/returning browser sessions
BPC-SC-001.when: a new participant signs in through the actual beta Google callback without a code and later signs out and back in, including abandoned or invalid callback variants
BPC-SC-001.then: only verified authentication SHALL create or recover the same admitted owner and private cabinet, with no automatic bonus, while invalid provider state or claims SHALL establish no authenticated owner session

BPC-SC-002.title: Private owner and configured admin boundaries reject foreign actors
BPC-SC-002.given: distinct owner sessions, agent credentials and configured administrator
BPC-SC-002.when: an owner uses the actual agent-management UI and a foreign owner, agent credential or unauthenticated caller tries private reads, owner mutations, code administration or report administration, including forged origin and administrator identity
BPC-SC-002.then: only the configured verified administrator SHALL access administration, owner controls SHALL persist only for their real owner, and rejected callers SHALL obtain neither private data nor unauthorized durable effects

BPC-SC-003.title: Admin code issuance preserves one immutable offer
BPC-SC-003.when: the administrator issues group and single-use codes through the real UI, retries after response loss or restart, and tries invalid amounts, limits or edits while an ordinary caller attempts issuance
BPC-SC-003.then: each valid operation SHALL persist one immutable offer and audit with one-time plaintext disclosure, recoverable issuance identity and exact terms, while invalid, conflicting or unauthorized operations SHALL create no additional code or financial credit

BPC-SC-004.title: Disabling a code stops only later uncommitted claims
BPC-SC-004.given: issued code and independent admin/redeemer sessions
BPC-SC-004.when: the administrator disables a code through the UI while an owner redemption races that action and both operations are retried
BPC-SC-004.then: committed serialization SHALL allow at most the eligible earlier redemption, reject later new claims, retain issued grants and exact usage, and persist the disable audit once without unauthorized callers changing state

BPC-SC-005.title: Owner redemption funds private training and full benchmark
BPC-SC-005.given: owners without credits, group/single codes and actual run readiness
BPC-SC-005.when: an owner activates a group code and another owner claims a single-use code through the actual UI, reads the balance and uses the credited lots for authorized training and full-benchmark admission/start, including insufficient balance or missing permission variants
BPC-SC-005.then: each eligible activation SHALL create one source-linked grant and receipt, valid runs SHALL reserve then debit their exact bonus allocations at ready start, private balances SHALL match independent ledger reads, and rejected claims or starts SHALL create no partial credit, cash substitution or unauthorized charge

BPC-SC-006.title: Concurrent and uncertain redemption cannot duplicate subsidy
BPC-SC-006.given: code with one remaining use and concurrent owners
BPC-SC-006.when: different owners race the last code use, one owner submits simultaneous claims with different keys, a claim transaction fails, or a committed response is lost and retried after restart with matching or conflicting payload
BPC-SC-006.then: successful claims SHALL stay within total capacity and one redemption per owner, failures SHALL consume no capacity or grant, matching retries SHALL return the original receipt, and conflicts SHALL create no extra grant, entry or cash effect

BPC-SC-007.title: Owner agent setup and revoke persist across remote clients
BPC-SC-007.given: private cards, four selected editions and explicit permissions/caps
BPC-SC-007.when: the owner creates a private agent, explicitly saves training/ranked permissions and spending limits, connects each selected client and replaces or revokes access through the actual UI around server restart
BPC-SC-007.then: preflight and domain tools SHALL enforce the persisted owner policy, old credentials SHALL fail after replacement/revoke, foreign-card or caller-supplied authority SHALL fail, and reconnect SHALL neither revive cancelled runs nor grant additional permissions

BPC-SC-008.title: Remote transport compatibility does not widen authority
BPC-SC-008.given: declared remote profiles and real UI-created matching intent
BPC-SC-008.when: selected native clients initialize and accept a real owner intent through the declared remote transports, replay acceptance through HTTP/MCP, or supply unsupported protocols, wrong resource, wrong redirect, wrong agent binding, untrusted client metadata or legacy messages outside their allowed profile
BPC-SC-008.then: only declared authenticated combinations SHALL connect and resolve one matching intent/run/reservation, rejection and retry SHALL create no duplicate effect or foreign access, and the default and local-only profiles SHALL preserve their declared behavior

BPC-SC-009.title: Codex model performs training and full12 on the beta host
BPC-SC-009.given: pinned actual Codex client with participant-owned real model
BPC-SC-009.when: the pinned real Codex application uses its participant-owned model and beta tools for a training selection and full twelve-task run, including ordinary solution failures and a connection interruption
BPC-SC-009.then: server observations SHALL establish model-driven actions, known graded completion with valid partial or zero credits and unchanged deadline/reconnect rules, private results and resource cleanup, while a scripted provider, platform unknown or missing external-client evidence SHALL NOT establish this positive gate

BPC-SC-012.when: the pinned real Hermes application uses its participant-owned model and beta tools for a training selection and full twelve-task run, including ordinary solution failures and a connection interruption

BPC-SC-013.title: Beta worker readiness and isolation are independently verified
BPC-SC-013.given: target-host beta, pinned source/release and independent observers
BPC-SC-013.when: the deployed beta starts and executes against its pinned BEF generation while invalid release/source pins, fixture configuration, raw-service access or foreign generation/run/task operations are attempted
BPC-SC-013.then: only the validated runtime SHALL prepare and execute its bound synthetic task effects, qualification manifests SHALL allow operator-restricted evidence collection for declared enabled but unverified profiles without claiming cohort readiness, release manifests SHALL require all four verified families, independent chain/database reads SHALL confirm isolation and fencing, and invalid readiness or forbidden access SHALL create no unauthorized effect or charged start

BPC-SC-014.title: All eight training tasks preserve selection price and evidence
BPC-SC-014.given: validated beta release and authorized funded training agents
BPC-SC-014.when: agents run single, multi-task and all-eight open training selections and attempt closed, mixed, repeated or invalid IDs, stale quotes or caller-supplied grades
BPC-SC-014.then: valid selections SHALL execute only their pinned ordered tasks with independently verified outcomes, exact fixed source charge and authorized detailed feedback, invalid selections SHALL create no reservation or execution, and supplied grade claims SHALL NOT replace authoritative grading

BPC-SC-015.title: Full12 grading and private feedback preserve the original contract
BPC-SC-015.given: pinned full12 release, real worker and independent readers
BPC-SC-015.when: a run progresses through all twelve tasks with valid, partial, ordinary failed or mandatory-violation outcomes and clients request results early, after completion or under foreign identities
BPC-SC-015.then: authoritative evaluation SHALL retain versioned evidence, exact aggregate and irreversible mandatory zeroing while later independent tasks continue, charge and completion SHALL occur once with fencing and released resources, and feedback SHALL obey ownership, ranked timing and closed-task disclosure limits

BPC-SC-016.title: Bounded queue and atomic start survive races and restart
BPC-SC-016.given: multiple funded owners/agents and pinned caps/deadlines
BPC-SC-016.when: multiple owners and agents concurrently fill pending and accepted queues, wait immediately before, at or after the original 24-hour deadline or across UTC rollover and race dispatch, retry, expiry and coordinator restart, including an allocated preparation whose fence fails during BEF outage
BPC-SC-016.then: configured caps and per-agent slots SHALL hold without owner starvation by a busy-agent head, queued work SHALL stay uncharged and untimed, and only a valid before-deadline ready start SHALL debit once while expired/rejected work cannot start, unfenced preparation remains visibly pending, and eventual confirmed fencing releases applicable original holds once without restarting or exceeding limits

BPC-SC-017.title: Cancellation and exhausted platform recovery choose one source outcome
BPC-SC-017.given: queued/started runs and a preserved committed action before a platform observation failure
BPC-SC-017.when: owner cancel/revoke races ready start and callbacks, or a real committed action loses its response and platform evidence recovery succeeds or exhausts its window around restart and repeated terminal delivery
BPC-SC-017.then: committed order SHALL select exactly one valid release or retained-charge cancellation path, recovery SHALL observe original effects without resubmission, exhausted platform failure SHALL retain unknown and one source-linked refund, and all terminal paths SHALL fence generations and release only their own slots without accepting forged failure reports as authority

BPC-SC-018.title: Owner form records linked and connection reports safely
BPC-SC-018.given: authenticated owner with own runs and an unlinked connection problem
BPC-SC-018.when: an owner submits reports through the actual website with and without own run context and optional uploaded screenshots, retries a lost committed response, or supplies foreign links, forbidden fields, oversized text, HTML or excess submissions
BPC-SC-018.then: valid reports SHALL persist one private receipt, safe context and any authorized screenshot links with no billing or run effect, retries SHALL recover it, and invalid or abusive submissions SHALL neither expose foreign/secret context nor create unauthorized records or executable content

BPC-SC-019.title: Native agents report under their actual principal without changing tasks
BPC-SC-019.given: four configured native clients and source snapshots
BPC-SC-019.when: each selected real client invokes the report tool through its declared connection with optional principal-owned screenshot uploads or subsequent authorized owner attachment on that agent report and repeats submission around restart, including revoked credentials, foreign run/action IDs, forged owner and attempts to use reporting as a task operation
BPC-SC-019.then: only the current authenticated principal SHALL create one recoverable own report, image links SHALL originate from its own upload or an audited attachment by its owner, no-run connection context SHALL be allowed when authorized, and reporting SHALL neither bypass access controls nor change action counts, funds, task state, timers or hidden-case exposure

BPC-SC-024.given: authenticated report owners/agents, private upload storage and cleanup job
BPC-SC-024.title: Private screenshot upload validates bytes and preserves ownership
BPC-SC-024.when: owners and authenticated agents upload and attach permitted images, retry around response loss and restart or race attachment with orphan cleanup, while corrupt, disguised, oversized, excessive, quota-exhausting, conflicting chunk retries, foreign or path/URL inputs and unauthorized image reads are attempted
BPC-SC-024.then: only bounded decoded and normalized private images SHALL be linked once to an authorized own or own-agent report with retained hashes, authenticated upload/chunk receipts and authorized owner/admin previews, invalid uploads or bindings SHALL expose no object or foreign data, orphan cleanup SHALL preserve committed images, and screenshot handling SHALL create no billing, task, grade or refund effect

BPC-SC-020.title: Admin triage persists filtered status changes without privilege leakage
BPC-SC-020.given: human/agent reports, admin and ordinary owner sessions
BPC-SC-020.when: the administrator opens human and agent reports and their screenshots in the actual admin UI, filters them and closes/reopens a report while another tab uses a stale revision and foreign owners or agents request the same detail or mutation
BPC-SC-020.then: authorized views and image content hashes SHALL match persisted reports and audited status revisions, stale changes SHALL conflict, and unauthorized actors SHALL obtain neither private detail/admin actions nor scoring or financial effects

BPC-SC-021.title: Target-host pause restart and resource admission preserve durable state
BPC-SC-021.given: target host with queued, running and completed work
BPC-SC-021.when: the real deployed beta accepts the bounded workload and then pauses admissions, loses process health, approaches its declared resource/disk limits and restarts with existing queued and running work
BPC-SC-021.then: new unready starts SHALL stop, authenticated reads/reports SHALL remain available where their dependencies are healthy, persistent state and original identities SHALL survive, and reconciliation or fencing SHALL prevent duplicate effects and leaked claims/slots without exposing private services

BPC-SC-022.title: Isolated restore retains credits reports and evidence without replayed effects
BPC-SC-022.given: verified checkpoint with codes, credits, reports and run evidence
BPC-SC-022.when: an operator restores the consistent beta backup into an isolated instance containing codes, redeemed grants, queued/completed/interrupted runs and human/agent reports with screenshots before and after their retention deadline, verifies hashes and retries original operations before enabling writes
BPC-SC-022.then: the restored records, screenshot bytes/hashes and required evidence SHALL reconcile to the backup's source totals and identities, missing or corrupt unexpired screenshot files SHALL prevent a complete-restore claim, restored expired report contents SHALL be purged before access and evaluated against deletion receipts rather than resurrected, unresolved outcomes SHALL remain unknown, retries SHALL produce no new grant/debit/task transaction, and the report SHALL state measured restore time, checkpoint loss window and same-host failure limitation

BPC-SC-023.title: Release bundle and cohort export reject unsupported readiness claims
BPC-SC-023.given: initial testers, complete contract inventory and bound activity records
BPC-SC-023.when: the operator assembles the target-host beta release bundle and activity/support export after initial testers, replays them read-only, and attempts release with a missing family, fixture-only model, blocked mandatory variant, stale source/hash or duplicated activity
BPC-SC-023.then: only a complete source-bound independently verified beta bundle SHALL permit cohort expansion, export counts SHALL deduplicate owner/operation identities and preserve failure/unknown and bonus attribution, and incomplete or contradictory evidence SHALL block release without changing old MVP gates or replaying effects

BPC-SC-025.title: Anonymous pages publish only marker-bound verified result summaries
BPC-SC-025.given: published and unpublished agents with authoritative complete run records
BPC-SC-025.when: anonymous and registered visitors view real public list/agent pages and API/cache surfaces before and after eligible full12 completion, retry or rebuild, including tied, partial and verified zero results, private training-only agents, incomplete/unknown runs and corrupt marker/result links
BPC-SC-025.then: only published cards and their coherent versioned best-run overall/four-tier summaries SHALL be visible to everyone, private data and closed-case details SHALL remain absent, unpublished cards SHALL match missing responses, and publication/rebuild SHALL neither alter grades nor expose unknown or forged results

BPC-SC-026.title: Retention purge and restore cannot resurrect expired reports
BPC-SC-026.given: audited beta end and reports/images before and after 30-day cutoff
BPC-SC-026.when: the administrator closes the beta and the report store reaches its 30-day deadline before or during cleanup, read/upload retries, restart or restoration of an older backup, including failed deletion and concurrent late attachment
BPC-SC-026.then: expired report content and screenshots SHALL be inaccessible and deleted through idempotent cleanup with non-content receipts, failed cleanup SHALL stay visible without renewed access, restored expired data SHALL be purged before serving, and official run grades and bonus accounting SHALL stay unchanged
